# Transporeon: Transport Operations API (legacy authentication)

- **Product:** Transporeon: Transport Operations API (legacy authentication) (Transportation family).
- **Disposition:** `reference`. The bridge never calls this API; operations can be searched with `trimble_api_operations` and validated into a dry-run plan with `trimble_api_plan` (omit `product`).
- **Authentication:** API key (legacy). Declared security schemes: ApiKeySecurity.
- **Access:** Existing Transport Operations integrations.
- **To call it you would need:** a legacy Transport Operations API key for rest.api.supplystack.com.
- **Documented servers:** `https://rest.api.supplystack.com`.
- **Definition:** [transporeon/transporeon-operations-v3-api-docs-transport-operations-legacy-authentication](https://api.transporeon.com/operations/v3/api-docs/Transport%20Operations%3A%20Legacy%20Authentication) (Transport Operations Integrations API, version 1.1.0). Documentation: https://transporeon-hcskb.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ADPD/pages/27230533/API+for+Transport+Operations+Legacy+Authentication.
